g.text: A dark hood, twin ivory eyes and a folded mantle. Appearance never encodes Alignment.
Eight directions · one rig · recolourable mantle
6 source directions + mirrored left diagonals; rooted feet, stable pivot.
Corpse is a separate folded pose. Eyes close; profile colour survives.
0.60 SECOND KILL / PRESENTATION AFTER SERVER ACCEPTANCE
Walk: 8 frames, 9–11 fps, 1.5 px mantle lag. No foot sliding.
UI: 140 ms fade / 180 ms position. No spring overshoot.
Work & fake work use the same 700 ms hand/light loop.
Reduced motion removes travel and shake; keeps state cues.
Use one server action identity; replay is visually idempotent.
Only permitted witnesses see local impact / hear local sound.
Own death: 180 ms local iris fade → “You are out of play”.
Corpse glow never reveals a body through walls or fog.
